items.title: New Cisco firewall zero-day exploited to crash SSL VPN devices
items.summary: Cisco released security updates to patch a denial-of-service zero-day in Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Threat Defense (FTD) software that attackers are exploiting to remotely crash vulnerable firewall devices. [...]

items.title: Attackers Exploit Second Cisco Firewall VPN Zero-Day Since August
items.summary: An exploited flaw in the Remote Access SSL VPN service lets unauthenticated attackers remotely force ASA and FTD firewalls to reload. The post Attackers Exploit Second Cisco Firewall VPN Zero-Day Since August appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day Exploitation Tied to Volt Typhoon’s ‘Silent Train’ Network
items.summary: Cisco Talos linked SD-WAN key-stealing malware to infrastructure overlapping Volt Typhoon’s Silent Train network, which Lumen detailed. The post Cisco SD-WAN Zero-Day Exploitation Tied to Volt Typhoon’s ‘Silent Train’ Network appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Binance probes potential $5.8 billion crypto-theft hack
items.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance is investigating a potential security breach involving up to $5.8 billion in digital assets, in what could become the largest cryptocurrency hack in history. [...]

items.title: Japan Airlines suffers third-party data breach exposing passenger info
items.summary: Japan Airlines (JAL) has announced that a data breach at Amadeus's Passenger Service System exposed the data of about 92,000 customers. [...]

items.title: Polymarket halts trading after crypto-draining script breach, $2.5M traced
items.summary: Prediction market platform Polymarket temporarily suspended trading on Thursday after hackers compromised a third-party service to distribute cryptocurrency-draining JavaScript, with approximately $2.5 million in assets traced to a suspected attacker wallet. [...]

items.title: BAE Says No Data Extracted in Incident Hitting Bankruptcy Courts
items.summary: BAE Systems says no data was extracted and no PII was breached in the incident that disrupted US bankruptcy court notices for weeks. The post BAE Says No Data Extracted in Incident Hitting Bankruptcy Courts appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: CISA warns of Fragnesia Linux flaw chained in PHP2Shell attacks
items.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies to patch a high-severity Linux kernel privilege escalation bug that attackers are chaining with the PHP2Shell flaws in the wild. [...]

items.title: Hugging Face malware campaign returns to hijack GPUs for crypto mining
items.summary: A crypto-mining campaign abusing Hugging Face models returned days after takedown, hijacking GPU servers and planting backdoors, with one model downloaded over 28,000 times. Separately, a fake Solana starter kit on GitHub is positioned to trick AI coding agents into installing a NetSupport RAT. [...]
